modelFields.coverageLabel: Complete 120-credit Psychology ledger with named course choices and separately sourced TESU transfer candidates.

institutionMinCredits.scope: Standard nonmilitary eligible-course residency; TECEP examinations do not replace the academic course-residency requirement.

externalMaxCredits.scope: Derived outside-credit bound for this standard residency scenario, separate from actual course placements.
externalMaxCredits.calculation: 120 degree credits minus 15 institutional course-residency credits.

alternativeMaxCredits.scope: Combined noncollegiate-credit ceiling; not a separate allowance for each provider.

upperMinCredits.scope: At least 18 upper-level credits within the 45-credit Psychology area of study, including its capstone.

gradePolicy.detail: C or better in English composition and all Psychology area-of-study courses; unrelated general education and electives retain their own rules.

transferPolicyReview.residencyNote: Standard nonmilitary 15-credit academic residency remains separate from the university-only information literacy and capstone courses; military, foreign-credit and Edison Accelerate scenarios require their own applicable policy.

rulesNotes: The three-credit PSY-3520 choice is one of the published Social Psychology elective alternatives.
PSY-3000 and PSY-3600 are the two published Psychology elective examples, chosen as a named baseline.
ECO-1110 and ECO-1120 are explicitly listed as Social Sciences in the university-linked selection source, and are not repeated in this baseline general education.
Each university code and original learning action is allocated once; Psychology in the area of study cannot also fulfill a general-education row.
Current catalog does not identify an academic-year edition in retrieved text; do not infer it from provider equivalency years.
The ten-year half-area and five-year Business Capstone currency rules explicitly apply to BS/BSBA, not this BA Psychology degree. Certificate currency terms are also not borrowed.
All provider awards are inherited only from existing exact same-school receiving-code evidence, retaining their original source conditions and dates.
The selected 45-credit area of study includes its capstone; upper-level free electives cannot replace the 18 upper-level area-of-study credits.
C or better is scoped to English composition and the area of study. Formal prerequisites PSY-1010 → PSY-3500 and MAT-1210 → STA-2010 are distinct from advisory background knowledge.
LIB-4960 is taken near completion under the published advisory, with no fabricated completed-credit threshold.
The standard 15-credit nonmilitary academic residency and separate 90-credit alternative-source maximum are retained. This does not represent a fully researched 105-credit outside basket.
This BA degree is not represented as a clinical psychologist license or a professional-practice qualification.
pricingNotes: Published tuition is an estimate basis; applicable fees, provider subscriptions, books and individual course availability remain separate.

providerEligibilityReview.scope: Provider review status only, independent of receiving-course equivalencies, exact degree placement, source recommendation periods and an individual student credit award. Provider review status establishes neither student enrollment permission nor a prohibition.
